headline: Foreign Investors Net Sell Taiwan Stocks NT$52.1 Billion; Formosa Plastics Hit Hardest with 36,000 Lots | Securities
summary: Taiwan stocks closed at 49,301.96, down 11.48 points, on trading value of NT$843.9 billion. Foreign investors net sold NT$52.2 billion, led by Formosa Plastics with 36,881 lots.
why: Formosa Plastics is a major Taiwanese petrochemical and plastics group, so its share moves reflect the petrochemical cycle. Sustained foreign selling signals shifting international positioning in Taiwan equities.

impacts.name: Formosa Plastics
impacts.why: Foreign investors net sold the largest volume of this stock on the day.
